about: Funder locations for the Humanitarians AI funders map. Every row is unreviewed: addresses were collected from web pages by AI agents and no person has confirmed them. source_page_opened_by_collector says whether the collector opened the source page; address_text_found_on_source_page is a separate automatic text match (null = the page could not be read by the script). Coordinates are Census geocoder matches (United States only). status geocoded means a coordinate exists; it does not mean the address is right. Do not treat a row as verified until a person reads the funder's own page.
